paragraphs: Rabbi Abba, son of Rav Safra, and Rabbi Yehoshua of Sikhnin, in Rabbi Levi’s name. (I did not find mention of this name. Perhaps it is a scribal error and should read “son of Rav Pappi,” mentioned above, who was with Rabbi Yehoshua of Sikhnin, in Rabbi Levi’s name.)
